# LizoCalc

> LizoCalc (lizocalc.com) is a free, no-signup online calculator platform. It offers browser-based calculators across Financial, Health, Math, Physics, Time, and Education categories, plus explainer blog content. All calculations run client-side — no user data is stored or transmitted to a server.

## Categories

- [Financial Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/financial): Mortgage, loan, auto loan, salary, interest, inflation, payment, and compound interest calculators.
- [Health Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/health): BMI, calorie, body fat, BMR, TDEE, sleep, and macros calculators.
- [Math Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/math): Scientific, fraction, percentage, triangle, LCM, GCF, and binary calculators.
- [Physics Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/physics): Density, speed, mass, and weight calculators.
- [Time Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/time): Age, date, time, and hours calculators.
- [Education Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators/education): GPA calculator and final grade calculator.
- [All Calculators](https://www.lizocalc.com/calculators): Full directory of every tool on the site.

## Guides

- [Finance Guides](https://www.lizocalc.com/blogs/finance): Worked examples and formula explainers for financial calculators.
- [Health Guides](https://www.lizocalc.com/blogs/health): Worked examples and formula explainers for health calculators.
- [Education Guides](https://www.lizocalc.com/blogs/education): Worked examples and formula explainers for education calculators.
- [Blog Hub](https://www.lizocalc.com/blogs): All blog content in one place.
